goal: Keep V9.1 usability while making new platform components visually native to the established Merit Register theme.
changes: Universal search trigger now uses the same mono pill language as primary navigation.
Search overlay uses paper/input/hairline/stamp tokens and editorial typography.
Workflow cards replaced by a quiet horizontal ledger stepper.
Homepage onboarding replaced by ruled editorial columns.
Page guidance converted from a generic callout box to an understated editorial note.
More menu and mobile quick navigation aligned with paper/stamp theme.
Homepage primary action cards reduced in height and typography to match original site cards.
